body.statement: Let \(\rho\) and \(\rho'\) be live prefixes ending at the same removed set \(A\). Then \(F(\rho)=F(\rho')\) if and only if \(\operatorname{Comp}(\rho)=\operatorname{Comp}(\rho')\). Moreover, if \(F(\rho)\ne F(\rho')\), then \(\operatorname{Comp}(\rho)\cap\operatorname{Comp}(\rho')=\varnothing\), and the legal suffix paths depend only on \(A\).
body.justification: Right congruence makes fragment merging complete rather than a heuristic numerical deduplication at the sink.
body.gap: WangEtAl2023EquivalenceClasses, Algorithmica 85 (2023), 3003--3023, doi:10.1007/s00453-023-01131-1, proves polynomial-delay quotient enumeration for local colors in decomposable acyclic AND--OR graphs. LiMVAM tuple equality is covariance-dependent and can be exposed only by later rows, so the required congruence must be proved from immutable original-label projections after source-to-sink pruning.
body.consumer: A calibration frontier can merge factorially many commuting root orders without losing or duplicating a future coefficient mechanism.
